versions.changelog:
kuaishou-guaikei-competitor-analysis v1.0.0

- Initial release providing structured analysis of public Kuaishou (快手) data.
- Supports keyword video search, creator (KOL) posts listing, and comment scraping, all via command-line.
- Designed for competitor monitoring, topic discovery, trend analysis, and KOL selection.
- Does not require Kuaishou login; only uses public data and supports up to 10,000 results per query.
- Requires GUAIKEI_API_TOKEN for API access.
- Flexible output in JSON suitable for further data processing and reporting.
